messages:
emily.sales: @eng_oncall Hey team — POC with NovaHealth blocked on SSO/SCIM. Users can authenticate but profile lacks email claim; Okta SCIM returns 400 when creating groups. Provisioned hosted API key for testing but they want Dedicated later. Any quick unblocks?

raj.patel: Which IdP and can you paste logs/snippet of errors?

emily.sales: Okta. SCIM error:
```
HTTP 400 Bad Request
{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:Error"],"detail":"Missing 'members' attribute","status":"400"}
```
SAML debug shows NameID present, but no 'email' attribute in assertion.

alex.kaplan: Sounds like attribute mapping in the Okta app. For SAML map `user.email` -> `email` attribute or set NameID Format to EmailAddress. For SCIM, Okta must send group `members` as an array of objects like `{ "value": "<id>", "display": "..." }` — our SCIM accepts `members` array with `value` fields. Can you share the Okta app mappings?

emily.sales: Can't paste screenshot here. Current mappings: `username -> user.login`, `displayName -> user.firstName + user.lastName`. No explicit email mapping.

mia.chen: Quick POC workaround: let users sign in with username temporarily, and create groups manually via the Admin API using the hosted key. Example curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/nh/groups \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-test-xxx" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"name":"poc-test","members":[{"id":"user_123","type":"user"}]}'
```

raj.patel: Also check Okta's SCIM Base URL and outgoing IPs — if there's a proxy or allowlist mismatch Okta's provisioning calls can hit a different endpoint and fail. @sso_team can you pull SCIM event logs for NovaHealth?

sso_team: Will take this — pls DM the Okta org ID and any API tokens. Also confirm whether flow is SP-initiated or IdP-initiated for SAML.

emily.sales: Sent DM with org ID + test token. One more: customer asked about Dedicated pricing and whether Dedicated requires separate SAML per tenant — they're multi-tenant inside their org.

alex.kaplan: Dedicated supports a single SAML config per customer by default. For per-tenant SAML we need enterprise setup (custom SAML routing) — AE will follow up on pricing/options.

emily.sales: Thanks — will update the customer once SCIM logs confirmed. :thumbsup:
